outcome: Hospital stay greater than five days
cohort: 305,001 women who gave birth at a military treatment facility from 2008 to 2014
finding: Obstructive sleep apnea is associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery, gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that obstructive sleep apnea was associated with higher odds of cesarean delivery.
